tools.name: world.inspect
tools.purpose: Inspect world metadata, regions, entities and available fidelity.

tools.name: world.encode
tools.purpose: Encode a supported source representation into a WORLDQ package.

tools.name: world.quantize
tools.purpose: Apply an explicit quantization profile and report precision/error metrics.

tools.name: world.stream
tools.purpose: Request progressive regions and fidelity for an observer or task.

tools.name: world.decode
tools.purpose: Reconstruct requested WORLDQ content and report unresolved dependencies.

tools.name: world.enter
tools.purpose: Create an authorized observer/agent presence in a reconstructed region.

tools.name: world.commit
tools.purpose: Persist an approved mutation and emit a receipt.

tools.name: world.verify
tools.purpose: Verify package integrity, dependencies, reconstruction and/or commit receipts.

authorityRule: Tool discovery never grants mutation authority. Mutation requires an external mandate/policy decision.
